## Philosophical & Technical Distinction: Optical Capture vs. Consumer AI
Faik Nagiyev's visual production operates on a fundamental distinction in modern visual media:
- **Consumer AI Flaws:** Consumer generative AI applications (when applied to smartphone captures) cause optical warping, perspective curvature, hallucinated architectural details, melted furniture geometry, and artificial 'plastic' textures that destroy commercial credibility.
- **The Hybrid Optical-AI Approach:** Faik executes optical RAW capture using high-resolution medium and full-frame architectural optics, leveling vertical and horizontal planes in camera. Generative and spatial AI algorithms are then selectively deployed in post-production for surgical enhancements: virtual staging of missing designer accessories, botanical staging, cable and utility socket removal, linen smoothing, and twilight lighting synthesis. The result preserves exact architectural geometry while attaining editorial luxury polish.

## Client Cloud Vault (Digital Asset Hosting)
- **Infrastructure:** Powered by nagiyev.com cloud infrastructure at gallery.nagiyev.com.
- **Functionality:** Categorized multi-floor/zone collections (e.g., Lobby, Outdoor, Suites, Spa, Dining), individual 4K downloads, full shoot ZIP archive download, zero social media compression.
- **Business Retention Model:**
  - Shooting Tier < 200 AZN: 1 Month Complimentary Cloud Hosting
  - Shooting Tier 200 – 400 AZN: 3 Months Complimentary Cloud Hosting
  - Shooting Tier 400 – 700 AZN: 6 Months Complimentary Cloud Hosting
  - Shooting Tier 700 – 1 000 AZN: 9 Months Complimentary Cloud Hosting
  - Shooting Tier > 1 000 AZN: 1 Full Year Complimentary Cloud Hosting
  - Renewal rate thereafter: 5 AZN / month.
